jobs.title: Staff Distributed Systems Engineer
jobs.refined_jd: We are seeking a Staff Distributed Systems Engineer to lead the architecture of our global event streaming and data persistence layer. You will design multi-region Raft consensus engines, optimize gRPC microservices throughput, and scale high-concurrency ingestion pipelines handling 500k+ requests per second.

boolean_strings.name: Tight (Go + Raft + Distributed)
boolean_strings.query: ("Go" OR "Golang") AND ("Distributed Systems" OR "Raft" OR "Paxos") AND ("gRPC" OR "Protobuf") AND ("Kubernetes" OR "k8s")

boolean_strings.name: Normal (High Concurrency Backend)
boolean_strings.query: ("Golang" OR "Rust") AND ("Microservices" OR "Event-Driven") AND ("Kafka" OR "NATS" OR "Pulsar") AND "Distributed"

boolean_strings.name: Broad (Systems & Cloud)
boolean_strings.query: ("Go" OR "Golang") AND ("Distributed Architecture" OR "Cloud Infrastructure") AND ("Docker" OR "Kubernetes")

jobs.candidate_pitch: High-impact staff role spearheading Apex Cloud's next-generation streaming engine. 100% remote with zero micromanagement, a direct line to the VP of Infra, and full autonomy over architecture decisions with modern Go 1.23+.
screening_questions: How many years of production experience do you have architecting distributed consensus mechanisms (Raft, Paxos, Etcd)?
Describe your experience profiling memory bottlenecks and goroutine leaks in high-throughput Go services.
What is your target hourly W2/C2C rate, and what is your current notice period?
jobs.notes: Hiring manager David wants someone who has hands-on experience scaling systems beyond single-region deployments. Fast 2-round interview loop.

jobs.title: Lead Fullstack Architect (React / Node)
jobs.refined_jd: Meridian Health is looking for a Lead Fullstack Architect to guide our patient intelligence interface and clinician dashboards. You will oversee front-end architecture (React 19, Next.js, TanStack Query), coordinate Node.js/GraphQL API gateways, and establish strict accessibility and medical data compliance standards.

boolean_strings.name: Tight (React 19 + TypeScript + GraphQL)
boolean_strings.query: ("React" OR "React.js") AND "TypeScript" AND ("GraphQL" OR "Apollo") AND ("Architecture" OR "Lead") AND ("Node.js" OR "Node")

jobs.candidate_pitch: Lead a team of 8 talented engineers building clinical interfaces that directly improve patient outcomes. Modern React 19 stack, high visibility with executive leadership, and structured transition to permanent leadership.
screening_questions: Can you walk through your approach to managing state across complex, real-time clinical workflows?
What strategies do you use to guarantee strict sub-second render performance with heavy data visualizations?
Are you comfortable with a hybrid schedule (2 days/week in the Boston Back Bay office)?
jobs.notes: Elena is looking for someone with strong leadership empathy who can mentor mid-level devs while keeping code standards sky high.

jobs.title: Senior AI / ML Research Engineer
jobs.refined_jd: Join Starlight AI to optimize model fine-tuning, KV-cache compression, and speculative decoding for our production enterprise LLM inference service. You will bridge foundational research and production deployment, maximizing GPU utilization across H100 clusters.

boolean_strings.name: Tight (PyTorch + CUDA + vLLM/Triton)
boolean_strings.query: ("PyTorch" OR "JAX") AND ("CUDA" OR "Triton") AND ("vLLM" OR "TensorRT-LLM" OR "DeepSpeed") AND ("Inference" OR "Serving")

boolean_strings.name: Normal (LLM Systems)
boolean_strings.query: "PyTorch" AND ("LLM" OR "Large Language Models") AND ("Fine-Tuning" OR "Quantization" OR "LoRA")

jobs.candidate_pitch: Work on the frontier of real-time LLM serving with immediate access to 256+ H100s. Direct collaboration with top AI researchers and generous equity/hourly compensation.
screening_questions: What experience do you have with low-bit quantization (AWQ, GPTQ) and KV-cache optimization in high-concurrency LLM inference?
Have you authored custom Triton or CUDA kernels to speed up attention mechanisms?
What is your target hourly rate and earliest start date?
jobs.notes: Chloe Chen conducts the first technical screen personally. She values practical GitHub repositories and concrete latency benchmarks.

jobs.title: VP of Engineering - Core Platform
jobs.refined_jd: FinVantage is seeking an executive engineering leader to manage our 45-person Core Platform organization. You will oversee algorithmic order routing, compliance telemetry, and high-frequency market data infrastructure while driving organizational agility.

boolean_strings.name: Tight (VP Engineering + FinTech / Trading)
boolean_strings.query: ("VP of Engineering" OR "Vice President Engineering" OR "Head of Engineering") AND ("Trading" OR "FinTech" OR "Capital Markets") AND ("C++" OR "Java" OR "Low Latency")

jobs.candidate_pitch: Premier Tier-1 investment firm offering industry-leading base compensation, uncapped bonus pool, and full executive mandate to modernize core trading systems.
screening_questions: How large were the engineering organizations you previously led, and how were they structured across managers and staff architects?
How do you approach balancing regulatory compliance with rapid deployment cycles in mission-critical financial systems?
